item.text: I’ll inspect the available LixRay connector/schema, then query only incomplete high-priority tasks and sort them by due date.

statements.sql:
SELECT
  t.table_name,
  t.table_type,
  c.column_name,
  c.data_type,
  c.is_nullable,
  c.ordinal_position
FROM information_schema.tables AS t
JOIN information_schema.columns AS c
  ON t.table_catalog = c.table_catalog
 AND t.table_schema = c.table_schema
 AND t.table_name = c.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema = 'public'
ORDER BY t.table_name, c.ordinal_position;

SELECT
  t.table_name,
  t.table_type,
  c.column_name,
  c.data_type,
  c.is_nullable,
  c.ordinal_position
FROM information_schema.tables AS t
JOIN information_schema.columns AS c
  ON t.table_catalog = c.table_catalog
 AND t.table_schema = c.table_schema
 AND t.table_name = c.table_name
WHERE t.table_schema = 'public'
ORDER BY t.table_name, c.ordinal_position;

SELECT title, owner, due_at
FROM acme_task
WHERE LOWER(priority) = 'high'
  AND done = FALSE
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  due_at ASC,
  title ASC;

FROM acme_task
WHERE LOWER(priority) = 'high'
  AND done = FALSE
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN due_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  due_at ASC,
  title ASC;
